facts.text: The hotel is a luxury beachfront hotel on Barbados' Platinum Coast.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Royal Pavilion is a luxury beachfront hotel located on Barbados’ renowned Platinum Coast.

facts.text: All guestrooms and suites are located directly on the beach, with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: All guestrooms and suites are located directly on the beach, offering uninterrupted ocean views

facts.text: The hotel was formerly The Miramar Hotel, built in the 1940s, and was the first hotel built on the west coast of Barbados.
facts.excerpt: formerly The Miramar Hotel, built in the 1940s and the first hotel to be constructed on the west coast of Barbados.

facts.text: The gardens were originally designed by South American landscape architect Fernando Tabora.
facts.excerpt: originally designed by renowned South American landscape architect, Fernando Tabora, are a joy.

facts.text: The hotel offers botanical garden tours every Wednesday at 10am.
facts.excerpt: Experience our botanical tours every Wednesday at 10am.

facts.text: Restaurants include Palm Terrace and Taboras.
facts.excerpt: dine at signature restaurants including Palm Terrace and Taboras

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served at the beachfront restaurant with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a time-honoured tradition at our beachfront restaurant, as you enjoy a beautiful afternoon tea service, set against picturesque ocean views.

facts.text: Guests can have dinner directly on the beach.
facts.excerpt: Dine directly on the beach with your toes in the sand with a meal specially prepared just for you.

facts.text: A three-bedroom villa sits in the gardens.
facts.excerpt: Our three-bedroom villa is nestled in lush gardens for ultimate privacy.

facts.text: Butler service is included with the Beachfront Suite.
facts.excerpt: Includes in-restaurant daily breakfast and butler service

facts.text: Watersports include paddleboarding, kayaking and snorkeling with turtles.
facts.excerpt: From paddleboarding to kayaking and snorkeling with the turtles, there's plenty of adventure to be found at Fairmont Royal Pavilion.

facts.text: Spa treatments are brought to guests in their own oceanfront room or suite.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Royal Pavilion brings the serenity of the spa directly to you in the privacy and comfort of your own oceanfront room or suite.

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor freshwater swimming pool and a heated jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Royal Pavilion has an outdoor freshwater swimming pool and a heated jacuzzi.

facts.text: The hotel has a tennis court with floodlights for night play.
facts.excerpt: Tennis court with flood lights for night play

facts.text: The resort is designed for couples seeking a romantic getaway or honeymoon.
facts.excerpt: The resort is designed for couples seeking a romantic getaway, honeymoon escape, or tranquil Caribbean retreat.

facts.text: The hotel is also described as suited to a family getaway.
facts.excerpt: Ideal for a romantic retreat or a family getaway

facts.text: Airport Platinum Fast Track service is available only on certain room categories and rates.
facts.excerpt: Platinum Fast Track Service – Airport Concierge (available on certain room categories & rates)
